exceptions.reason: No fixed release (<=4.0.7; the upstream fix micromatch/picomatch#194 is not merged). It comes only through the test tool vitest (via vite, tinyglobby and fdir), a devDependency, so the published package does not carry it (pnpm audit --prod finds nothing high). The only glob patterns vitest receives are the ones written in this repository's configs; nothing passes a pattern in from outside.
